langchain.gap_note: 40 pages got Firecrawl-only content without LangChain enhancement

n8n.note: 3 JSON workflow files created but n8n never started/imported. Pipeline run manually.

world_map.lesson: Use real SVG path data for geographic visualizations, never generate shapes from scratch

lessons_learned: Safety gate must run BEFORE injection, not after
Sanitize LangChain output: strip code fences, enforce single H1, remove raw notes
Use real SVG path data for geographic content
Write progress.json after each chunk to survive context compaction
Build after each chunk commit, not just at the end
Use delegate_task for parallel chunk processing
Actually start n8n and import the workflow — don't leave it as JSON artifacts
Run LangChain enhancement on ALL pages, not just top 32
Visual QA after each chunk: screenshot sample pages, not just homepage
